name: Create Mathematical Calculation Module
description: Creates a TypeScript module with mathematical calculation functions (such as sphere volume), including input validation, error handling, and JSDoc documentation
steps: Check if required folder exists, create it if not
Create the calculation file (e.g., sphere.ts) in the target directory
Implement the mathematical formula (e.g., V = (4/3) * π * r³)
Add input validation with proper error handling for negative/invalid values
Add JSDoc documentation with parameter descriptions and throws clauses
Provide a summary with the created functions and their usage
